scope: Passive full-address CPU markers, POKEY timestamps and I-flag transitions between emulator microstates; no guest instructions/cycles added
build_options: Same as toolchain/altirra-build.json, build/latency target AltirraBridgeServer
resolution: I transitions sampled between CPU microstates, including RTI followed immediately by IRQ. 1/8 base-cycle timestamps at 8x; includes NMI/ROM/DMA elapsed time. Not a hardware worst-case guarantee.
